title: desktop.uia.set_text (request, Brain -> Body) payload
description: Replace the text of one edit field of an allowlisted app (amendment 19) through the Value pattern, never keystrokes; it never presses Enter. Always needs confirm_id (amendment 20). The text may not contain control characters other than tab and newline, nor bidirectional or zero-width characters.

element.description: Which element: name (case-insensitive, exact) and/or automation_id (exact); control_type narrows it. Exactly one element must match.
